What each forge supports, emulates or lacks, from the factory's capability table. The console, the connect dialog and the engine's refusals read the same table: a step that needs something a forge lacks fails with `forge_capability_unavailable` and the reason below. Connecting each forge is in [Forge connections](/control/forge-connections/).

| Forge | API dialect | A pull request is called |
|---|---|---|
| GitHub | `github` | pull request |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | `github` | pull request |
| Gitea | `gitea` | pull request |
| Forgejo | `gitea` | pull request |
| GitLab | `gitlab` | merge request |

## Capabilities

### Connect

<span id="connect"></span>How the factory signs in to the forge. (`connect`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Emulated: A GitHub App you register on the instance; its App id and private key are kept in the tenant vault. |
| Gitea | Emulated: A bot account's access token in the tenant vault stands in for an App installation. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: A bot account's access token in the tenant vault stands in for an App installation. |
| GitLab | Emulated: A bot user's, group's or project's access token in the tenant vault stands in for an App installation. |

### Webhooks

<span id="webhooks"></span>Events reach the factory as they happen; nothing is polled while webhooks arrive. (`webhooks`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: Repository or organisation webhooks the factory creates with the connection's secret, signed with X-Gitea-Signature or X-Forgejo-Signature. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: Repository or organisation webhooks the factory creates with the connection's secret, signed with X-Gitea-Signature or X-Forgejo-Signature. |
| GitLab | Emulated: Project or group webhooks the factory creates with the connection's secret token (X-Gitlab-Token). |

### Repository discovery

<span id="repos"></span>The repositories the connection can reach are listed for Repositories and managed scope. (`repos`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: The organisation's or the bot user's repositories, refreshed every 6 hours and on Refresh. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: The organisation's or the bot user's repositories, refreshed every 6 hours and on Refresh. |
| GitLab | Emulated: The group's projects including subgroups, or the bot's memberships, refreshed every 6 hours and on Refresh. |

### Open pull requests

<span id="pull_requests"></span>The draft_pr output and Belai crews open pull requests from factory branches. (`pull_requests`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Yes |
| Forgejo | Yes |
| GitLab | Emulated: A merge request; its number is the merge request's iid. |

### Draft and ready

<span id="draft"></span>A pull request is opened as a draft and marked ready at a checkpoint. (`draft`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: The WIP: title prefix, which Gitea and Forgejo treat as work in progress and refuse to merge. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: The WIP: title prefix, which Gitea and Forgejo treat as work in progress and refuse to merge. |
| GitLab | Emulated: The Draft: title prefix, which GitLab treats as a draft merge request. |

### Checks for gates

<span id="checks"></span>A gate waits for the head commit's checks to pass. (`checks`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: Commit statuses. Gitea and Forgejo Actions, Woodpecker and Drone all report through them. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: Commit statuses. Gitea and Forgejo Actions, Woodpecker and Drone all report through them. |
| GitLab | Emulated: Commit statuses, which every pipeline job reports. |

### Merge readiness

<span id="merge_state"></span>The approve gate reads whether a pull request is clean, behind, conflicted or blocked. (`merge_state`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: Worked out from mergeable, the reviews and the statuses. Branch protection is not read; the forge still enforces it on merge. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: Worked out from mergeable, the reviews and the statuses. Branch protection is not read; the forge still enforces it on merge. |
| GitLab | Yes |

### Review decision

<span id="review_decision"></span>Whether a pull request is approved, needs a review or has changes requested. (`review_decision`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: Worked out from each reviewer's latest review; stale and dismissed reviews do not count. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: Worked out from each reviewer's latest review; stale and dismissed reviews do not count. |
| GitLab | Emulated: Read from the merge request's approvals; a requested change is a note, not a state. |

### Submit reviews

<span id="reviews"></span>pr_review nodes approve, comment on or request changes to a pull request, with inline comments. (`reviews`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Yes |
| Forgejo | Yes |
| GitLab | Emulated: APPROVE is an approval, COMMENT a note, REQUEST_CHANGES a note with this account's approval withdrawn; inline comments are diff discussions. |

### Request a team's review

<span id="team_reviewers"></span>A checkpoint can ask a team to review. (`team_reviewers`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Yes |
| Forgejo | Yes |
| GitLab | Not available: GitLab reviewers are users; name the people instead. |

### Update branch

<span id="update_branch"></span>A checkpoint brings a pull request's branch up to date with its base. (`update_branch`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: A merge of the base into the head (pulls/{n}/update?style=merge). |
| Forgejo | Emulated: A merge of the base into the head (pulls/{n}/update?style=merge). |
| GitLab | Emulated: A rebase of the merge request (merge_requests/{iid}/rebase). |

### Server-signed commits

<span id="signed_commits"></span>Commits the factory writes (conflict resolution, curator ships) are signed with the tenant's KMS key. (`signed_commits`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: The signed commit is built by the factory and pushed over git; the forge shows it verified when the key is on the signer's account. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: The signed commit is built by the factory and pushed over git; the forge shows it verified when the key is on the signer's account. |
| GitLab | Emulated: The signed commit is built by the factory and pushed over git; GitLab shows it verified when the key is on the signer's account. |

### Issue and label sync

<span id="issues"></span>Board cards mirror to issues both ways, with sf: and belai: labels. (`issues`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: Labels are written by id; a missing label is created first. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: Labels are written by id; a missing label is created first. |
| GitLab | Yes |

### Close reason

<span id="close_reason"></span>An issue closed as not planned is told apart from one closed as completed. (`close_reason`)

| Forge | Support |
|---|---|
| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Not available: Gitea and Forgejo issues have no close reason; the card records it on the board only. |
| Forgejo | Not available: Gitea and Forgejo issues have no close reason; the card records it on the board only. |
| GitLab | Not available: GitLab issues have no close reason; the card records it on the board only. |

### Rate-limit budget

<span id="rate_limit"></span>The quota guard shares the forge's call budget between the factory and everything else. (`rate_limit`)

| Forge | Support |

| GitHub | Yes |
| GitHub Enterprise Server | Yes |
| Gitea | Emulated: Gitea and Forgejo send no rate-limit headers; the guard counts calls against forge.calls_per_hour. |
| Forgejo | Emulated: Gitea and Forgejo send no rate-limit headers; the guard counts calls against forge.calls_per_hour. |
| GitLab | Yes |

## Trigger events

The event names a trigger uses are GitHub's. Each forge's deliveries are translated into them; an event a forge cannot send never starts a run for its repositories.

| Event | GitHub Enterprise Server | Gitea | Forgejo | GitLab |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `check_run` | Yes | Emulated: From a commit status (the status event): completed when the status is final. Gitea 1.22 has no status event and keeps a webhook without it, so check_run triggers do not fire there; gates still read the statuses. | Emulated: From a commit status (the status event): completed when the status is final. Gitea 1.22 has no status event and keeps a webhook without it, so check_run triggers do not fire there; gates still read the statuses. | Emulated: Job Hook. |
| `check_suite` | Yes | Not available: No check suites; trigger on check_run. | Not available: No check suites; trigger on check_run. | Not available: No check suites; trigger on check_run or workflow_run. |
| `code_scanning_alert` | Yes | Not available: No security alerts. | Not available: No security alerts. | Not available: No security alerts. |
| `dependabot_alert` | Yes | Not available: No security alerts. | Not available: No security alerts. | Not available: No security alerts. |
| `deployment_status` | Yes | Not available: No deployment events. | Not available: No deployment events. | Emulated: Deployment Hook. |
| `installation_repositories` | Yes | Emulated: The connection's repository refresh. | Emulated: The connection's repository refresh. | Emulated: The connection's repository refresh. |
| `issue_comment` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Emulated: Note Hook on an issue or merge request. |
| `issues` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Emulated: Issue Hook. |
| `merge_group` | Yes | Not available: No merge queue. | Not available: No merge queue. | Not available: Merge trains are not read. |
| `pull_request` | Yes | Emulated: pull_request and its label, assign, sync and review-request variants; a WIP: title change is converted_to_draft or ready_for_review. | Emulated: pull_request and its label, assign, sync and review-request variants; a WIP: title change is converted_to_draft or ready_for_review. | Emulated: Merge Request Hook. |
| `pull_request_review` | Yes | Emulated: pull_request_review_approved, _rejected and _comment. | Emulated: pull_request_review_approved, _rejected and _comment. | Emulated: Merge Request Hook approved and unapproved actions. |
| `pull_request_review_comment` | Yes | Not available: Gitea sends review comments as pull_request_comment, an issue_comment. | Not available: Gitea sends review comments as pull_request_comment, an issue_comment. | Emulated: A diff note (Note Hook with a position). |
| `push` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| `registry_package` | Yes | Not available: Package events are not mapped. | Not available: Package events are not mapped. | Not available: No package events. |
| `release` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Emulated: Release Hook. |
| `repository` | Yes | Emulated: Organisation webhooks only. | Emulated: Organisation webhooks only. | Not available: GitLab sends no project-created event to a project hook. |
| `secret_scanning_alert` | Yes | Not available: No security alerts. | Not available: No security alerts. | Not available: No security alerts. |
| `secret_scanning_alert_location` | Yes | Not available: No security alerts. | Not available: No security alerts. | Not available: No security alerts. |
| `workflow_run` | Yes | Emulated: workflow_run from Gitea 1.24 and Forgejo 11; older versions send statuses only (check_run). | Emulated: workflow_run from Gitea 1.24 and Forgejo 11; older versions send statuses only (check_run). | Emulated: Pipeline Hook. |
